en.topic_title: In Pictures: How Hong Kong’s Gen Z rappers are navigating their careers online
en.topic_summary:
Words by James Lee



Hong Kong’s local rap scene has been going through a dry spell lately. Shows, as with other independent music scenes, have shrunken in size and dropped in frequency since the days of the Covid-19 pandemic, when local subcultures rallied around homegrown talent.



Cheeseekit at a rap concert on July 26, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.
